cities.name: Berlin

interests.name: History & Landmarks 🏰
interests.description: Iconic monuments, Cold War sites and some of Europe’s most historic buildings.

interests.name: Street Art & Culture 🎭
interests.description: Creative neighborhoods, murals, alternative art spaces and famous graffiti walls.

interests.name: Parks & Riverside 🌳
interests.description: Huge green parks, canal walks and scenic paths along the River Spree.

cities.local_food_tip: Try currywurst (mild options available), giant pretzels, schnitzel, vegetarian döner, potato dishes and Berlin-style pastries. Alexanderplatz and Friedrichshain have many quick snacks and bakeries.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏛️ Brandenburg Gate → 🏛️ Reichstag Building → 🕊️ Holocaust Memorial → ☕ Coffee at Potsdamer Platz. Afternoon: 🎨 East Side Gallery → 🧱 Berlin Wall Memorial or Checkpoint Charlie Museum → 🍽️ Lunch in Friedrichshain or Alexanderplatz → Walk around Alexanderplatz. Sunset: 🌅 Oberbaum Bridge. Night: 🌃 Evening stroll through Kreuzberg—creative streets, cafés and dessert spots (no clubbing needed).

ideas: 🌸 Blossoms and flea markets in Mauerpark.
🌊 Riverside paths along the River Spree.
🎶 Outdoor music around the RAW-Gelände area.

public_transport_tips: 🚇 U-Bahn is the fastest way to move around central Berlin.
🚋 Trams cover creative districts like Friedrichshain and Prenzlauer Berg.
🚶 Many major sights are walkable within central Berlin.
📱 Use BVG App for real-time routes: https://www.bvg.de/en

cities.name: Cologne
cities.local_food_tip: Highly recommended: soft pretzels, warm soups, potato dishes and simple sweet pastries from local bakeries.
cities.full_day:
Morning: ⛪ Start at the Cologne Cathedral — an immense Gothic masterpiece. → 🏛️ Explore the Old Town streets filled with colorful houses and small shops. → 🌉 Cross or photograph the Hohenzollern Bridge with its famous love-locks. → ☕ Take a relaxing riverside break with pastries.

Afternoon: 🎨 Visit Museum Ludwig — perfect for modern art fans. → 🌊 Walk along Rheinpromenade for breezy views. → 🍽️ Lunch: Pretzels, soups, bowls or vegetarian options in nearby cafés.

Sunset: 🌅 Enjoy the skyline from Rheinboulevard in Deutz — one of the most iconic photo spots.

Night: 🌃 Explore the Chocolate Museum area and take a gentle riverside walk with evening lights.

ideas: 📸 Spring photos with cathedral & bridge backdrop.
☕ Sunny outdoor cafés along the Rhine.
🍁 City skyline framed by golden foliage.
🏛️ Museum Ludwig for cozy cultural afternoons.

public_transport_tips: 🚇 U-Bahn reaches all major areas quickly.
🚶 Old Town is extremely walkable.
🚋 Trams along the river offer great scenic shortcuts.
📱 Use the KVB app for real-time travel info.

city_events.name: Cologne Lights
city_events.description: 🎆 A spectacular fireworks and light show along the Rhine.

recommended_places.name: Cologne Cathedral
recommended_places.why_visit: Germany’s most iconic Gothic cathedral — breathtaking inside and out.

recommended_places.name: Hohenzollern Bridge
recommended_places.why_visit: Famous for its love-locks and stunning city views.

recommended_places.name: Rheinboulevard Deutz
recommended_places.why_visit: Top-tier sunset viewpoint over the entire Cologne skyline.

cities.name: Dresden

interests.name: Baroque Architecture 🏰
interests.description: Ornate palaces, courtyards, terraces and grand riverfront façades.

interests.name: Art & Museums 🎨
interests.description: World-class galleries including Raphael’s iconic works.

interests.name: Riverside Views 🌊
interests.description: The 'Balcony of Europe' overlooking the Elbe River.

cities.local_food_tip: Try Dresdner Eierschecke (local cake), mild Saxon dishes, potato soups and pastries — easy comforting food while exploring the city.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Zwinger Palace: Iconic baroque courtyards and fountains. → 🎨 Old Masters Gallery. → ☕ Coffee near Semperoper. Afternoon: ⛪ Frauenkirche: Beautifully reconstructed baroque church. → 🌉 Brühl’s Terrace. → 🍽️ Light Saxon lunch. Sunset: 🌅 Augustus Bridge. Night: 🌃 Neustadt stroll: creative cafés, murals and relaxed evening vibes.

ideas: ⛴️ Elbe boat rides with skyline views.

public_transport_tips: 🚋 Trams are the fastest way to move through central Dresden.
🚶 Old Town is walkable and compact.
🚌 Buses reach riverside paths and hills.
📱 DVB App recommended for routes and tickets.

Afternoon: 🏙️ MedienHafen modern district. → 🎨 Visit Museum K20 or Museum K21. → 🍽️ Lunch: noodles, pastries, pretzels. Sunset: 🌅 Rheinturm Tower. Night: 🌃 Old Town cafés and dessert spots for a relaxed evening.

🚋 Trams go directly to MedienHafen.
📱 Use the Rheinbahn app for real-time travel info.

cities.local_food_tip: Try käsespätzle, potato dumplings, pretzels, breads, soups and vegetarian Bavarian dishes. Munich’s beer gardens always have strong non-alcoholic options.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏙️ Marienplatz → 🏛️ Neues Rathaus & Glockenspiel → 🛒 Viktualienmarkt snacks. Afternoon: 🏰 Nymphenburg Palace & gardens → 🍽️ Lunch with Bavarian specialties. Sunset: 🌅 Monopteros viewpoint in the English Garden. Night: 🌃 Evening walk through Schwabing — cozy cafés and dessert spots.

ideas: 🏊 Cooling off along the Isar riverbanks.
🥐 Cozy bakery cafés in the center.
⭐ Snowy forest walks in the English Garden.

public_transport_tips: 🚇 U-Bahn moves quickly around the city — MVV is the local network.
🚌 Buses reach parks and outer districts.
🚶 The entire Old Town is walkable.

Night: 🌃 Evening walk around Kröpcke Square — lively and beautifully lit.

cities.name: Hamburg

interests.name: Harbor & Waterfront 🌊
interests.description: Harbor promenades, ferries, docks and constant waterfront activity.

interests.name: Modern Architecture 🏛️
interests.description: Glass towers, futuristic concert halls and bold urban design.

interests.name: Art & Creative Districts 🎨
interests.description: Historic red-brick warehouses filled with culture, museums and canals.

cities.local_food_tip: Hamburg is famous for fish dishes, but mild versions of fish sandwiches, potato dishes, soups, pretzels and bakery snacks make great easy meals. Try pastries around Jungfernstieg or Speicherstadt.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🌉 Landungsbrücken: Walk by the harbor and watch ferries and ships. → 🚢 Elbphilharmonie Plaza: Ride to the viewing platform for panoramic views. → 🏛️ Speicherstadt historic warehouses. Afternoon: 🎡 Miniatur Wunderland: The world’s largest miniature exhibition. → 🏙️ HafenCity modern district walk. → 🍽️ Lunch around the harbor: potatoes, soups or bakery snacks. Sunset: 🌅 Dockland or Altonaer Balkon. Night: 🌃 Illuminated Speicherstadt bridges and canals.

ideas: 🌳 Shade and ponds in Planten un Blomen park.

public_transport_tips: 🚇 U-Bahn and S-Bahn cover all major areas quickly.
🚢 Ferries (HVV 62) are part of public transport — cheap sightseeing!
🚶 Speicherstadt and HafenCity are best explored on foot.
📱 HVV App: https://www.hvv.de/en
